title: Stock Market Today, March 2: Netflix Advances After Dropping Pursuit of Warner Bros. Deal
title_zh: 3 月 2 日今日股市：Netflix 在放弃华纳兄弟交易后股价上涨
summary: Netflix rose as investors backed management’s decision to forgo a Warner Bros. acquisition, favoring balance-sheet discipline and organic cash flow growth.
summary_zh: Netflix 股价上涨，因投资者支持管理层放弃华纳兄弟收购的决定，支持资产负债表纪律和有机现金流增长。

title: AES to Be Taken Private in $33 Billion Deal. Why It’s the S&P 500’s Worst Stock Today.
title_zh: AES 将以 330 亿美元的交易私有化。为什么它是今天标准普尔 500 指数中表现最差的股票。
summary: AES  the utilities and clean energy company, is being taken private by an investor consortium that includes an  EQT Group  infrastructure fund and  BlackRock  -owned Global Infrastructure Partners.
summary_zh: AES 是一家公用事业和清洁能源公司，正在被一个投资者财团私有化，该财团包括 EQT 集团基础设施基金和贝莱德旗下的全球基础设施合作伙伴。

title: Tech stocks today: Nvidia invests $4B in photonics makers, Apple announces low-cost iPhone, OpenAI strikes deal with Pentagon
title_zh: 今日科技股：英伟达向光子制造商投资 40 亿美元，苹果推出低成本 iPhone，OpenAI 与五角大楼达成协议
summary: All eyes are on Nvidia's fourth quarter results, due after the closing bell on Wednesday, as AI concerns continue to grip markets.
summary_zh: 由于人工智能担忧继续困扰市场，所有目光都集中在英伟达将于周三收盘后公布的第四季度业绩。

title: This Networking Stock Is Set to Win on an AMD-Meta Deal — and It Pays a Dividend Too
title_zh: 这支网络股票将在 AMD-Meta 交易中获胜——而且它也会带来股息
summary: Cisco offers a straightforward way to play Meta’s $100 billion-plus AMD AI chip deal because every new GPU rack needs a high-performance, power-efficient network.
summary_zh: 思科提供了一种直接的方式来参与 Meta 价值超过 1000 亿美元的 AMD AI 芯片交易，因为每个新的 GPU 机架都需要高性能、高能效的网络。

title: Is Blackstone’s (BX) ESOP Stock Offering Quietly Reframing Its Private Credit And Power Ambitions?
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 的 ESOP 股票发行是否正在悄然重塑其私人信贷和权力野心？
summary: In late February 2026, Blackstone filed a shelf registration for approximately US$1.47 billion of common stock, linked to an ESOP-related offering of 12,765,875 shares.
summary_zh: 2026 年 2 月下旬，Blackstone 提交了约 14.7 亿美元普通股的搁置登记，与 ESOP 相关的 12,765,875 股发行相关。
